question: Mechanical energy is the sum of potential energy and ______ energy.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kinetic.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mechanical energy is a combination of Kinetic energy and Potential energy.
 
• Mechanical energy is defined as the sum total of kinetic energy and potential energy in an object that is utilized to do work.
 
• Mechanical energy is a form of energy that is related to the position and motion of an object.
 
• The sum of potential energy and kinetic energy gives the mechanical energy which is the total energy that is associated with the position and motion of the object:
 
 
• i.e., M.E = K.E + potential energy.
 
• The energy of an object due to its motion is called kinetic energy.
 
• The energy of an object due to its position is the potential energy.
